descriptions.en: Much as music enriches the atmosphere, the Motetique Signa enhances your appearance.
descriptions.zh: 正如音乐可以点缀氛围一般，圣歌头环亦可美化你的外表。

descriptions.en: Citrine Aphrodita inspires epics of undying devotion with this graceful signature signa.
descriptions.zh: 辉光晶灵美神以这一优美的头环激发了人们对不朽献身精神的无限向往。

descriptions.en: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the thirteenth anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.
descriptions.zh: 这是莲为第一位从低温催眠中醒来的天诺战士所准备的一份十三周年纪念礼物。

descriptions.en: Bring elegance to your look with this regal wreath.
descriptions.zh: 这款高贵的花环为你带来优雅的气质。
来自古代的头环，其装饰象征着智慧与力量。

descriptions.en: This signa pays tribute to your steadfast dedication in the face of the mind-tormenting Murmur.
descriptions.zh: 这个头环致敬你在面对令人心神不宁的低语者时始终如一的坚定奉献。

descriptions.en: Though the influence of the Indifference grows stronger, this evolution of the Invictus signa proves that your defiance grows in equal measure.
descriptions.zh: 尽管虚空无情之物的影响日益增强，但不屈头环的进化证明了你的反抗精神也在以同样的力度增长。

descriptions.en: The supreme version of this signa, signifying the denial of Neci Rusalka's false Duviri in Operation: Eight Claw.
descriptions.zh: 这个头环的最高版本，标志着在《行动代号：八爪》中对内奇·鲁莎卡那虚假双衍王境的否定。

descriptions.en: A bloodstained gaze washes all in red.
descriptions.zh: 猩红的目光将一切都染成了红色。

descriptions.zh: 没有迅电驰影摩托的标志性头环，任何极速战士的造型都不算完整。

descriptions.zh: 猎物无法躲避暴食者暴坦标志性头环那穿透一切的目光。

descriptions.zh: 圣枪弥撒传家宝的标志性头环揭示了这位流浪执法者令人眼花缭乱的隐藏一面。

descriptions.zh: 蕴含着原始力量的角赋予狂野犀牛野兽的威严。

descriptions.zh: 这带有金色尖刺的头环以苦难铸就瑰丽。

descriptions.en: Exemplify sophistication with every step.

descriptions.zh: 据说靠近幻纹的人们能听到邪恶的低语，但这显然是些虚幻的传闻。
从这个幻纹中能感到无尽的邪恶风格。

descriptions.en:
A warrior walks, alone in crowds
Companion to moon and mist and bat
With a vision grim the mind enshrouds
This fearsome, deathborne aristocrat.
descriptions.zh:
孤傲的战士，独行于族群
唯有月雾蝠，常伴其左右
眼神若冰霜，内心亦朦胧
化身为恐惧，死亡之贵族

descriptions.en: A blazingly regal Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
descriptions.zh: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的炽烈尊贵幻纹。

descriptions.en: An icily imperious Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
descriptions.zh: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的冰冷傲慢幻纹。

descriptions.en: Hatch venomous plots in this Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
descriptions.zh: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的、生出恶毒阴谋的幻纹。

descriptions.en: A magnetically compelling Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
descriptions.zh: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的磁性引力幻纹。

descriptions.en: A radiant Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
descriptions.zh: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的辐射幻纹。

descriptions.en: A striking Ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Sister of Parvos.
descriptions.zh: 从一个感化或消灭的帕尔沃斯的姐妹处得到的冲击幻纹。

descriptions.en: Wings to lift your love starward.
descriptions.zh: 让你的爱展翅飞向星空。

descriptions.en: Pestilent sores and bubbles burst with your every move.
descriptions.zh: 致命的脓包随着你的一举一动而膨胀爆裂。

descriptions.en: Commemorate 12 cycles since the Tenno first awoke with this graceful ephemera.
descriptions.zh: 通过这款优雅的幻纹纪念天诺战士首次苏醒以来的 12 个周期。

descriptions.en: Soak off with this Dog Days Ephemera - Only for a limited time!
descriptions.zh: 沉浸在这个三伏天幻纹中 — 仅在限定时间内可用！
愿舞霜剑姬的标志性幻纹将寒意伴着冰冷的拥抱降临于你。
召唤冰霜精灵环绕着你。

descriptions.en: Levitating crystals weave a web of luminous connections. Gara Prime’s signature ephemera.
descriptions.zh: 轻盈的水晶编织出晶莹剔透的网。圣装琉璃仕女的标志性幻纹。

descriptions.en: Coiling, hissing, the spirits of flame ride with their kin.
descriptions.zh: 盘旋缠绕、嘶嘶作响，烈焰之灵与其亲族同行。

descriptions.en: Luminous plasma leaps off surfaces in your presence.
descriptions.zh: 发光的等离子体会在你所经之处跃出地面。

names.zh: 圣装圣艾尔摩之火幻纹

descriptions.en: Mark the path to a new season with a trail of decorative eggs - only for a limited time!
descriptions.zh: 布置装饰性蛋来标记通往新季节的道路-只在限定的时间内！

descriptions.en: Move as the Eidolons and burn the ground coldly with footsteps of shimmering Void energy.
descriptions.zh: 像夜灵般移步，以闪烁的虚空能量，无情地践踏并焚烧地面。

descriptions.en: Your Warframe leaves crackling footprints in its wake.
descriptions.zh: 让战甲在身后留下劈啪作响的足迹。

descriptions.en: Your Warframe leaves flaming footprints in its wake.
descriptions.zh: 让战甲在身后留下火焰般的足迹。

descriptions.en: Your Warframe leaves icy footprints in its wake.
descriptions.zh: 让战甲在身后留下结冰的足迹。

descriptions.en: Leave a trail of fireflies and forest leaves in your wake.
descriptions.zh: 在你身后留下一道萤火虫和树叶的足迹。

descriptions.en: Your Warframe leaves grassy footprints in its wake.
descriptions.zh: 让战甲在身后留下绿意盎然的足迹。

descriptions.en: Bathe in the life essence of your enemies.
descriptions.zh: 在敌人的生命精华中徜徉。

descriptions.en: Spread Garuda Prime's wings of slaughter with this flowing Ephemera.
descriptions.zh: 用这款流动的幻纹展开圣装迦楼罗的杀戮之翼。

descriptions.en: The ground trembles to herald your arrival. Grendel Turbis' signature ephemera.
descriptions.zh: 大地震颤，宣告你的到来。暴食者暴坦的标志性幻纹。

descriptions.en: Take on the look of a monster that can devour an enemy in a single bite.
descriptions.zh: 呈现出一个能一口吞噬敌人的怪物形象。

descriptions.en: Jump in, the water’s fine.
descriptions.zh: 跳进去，水刚好。

descriptions.en: Emanate Infested spores.
descriptions.zh: 散发感染孢子。

descriptions.en:
"Time will show the way, And I'll mend the heart you've broken"

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
descriptions.zh:
"年华流逝，我将愈合你心上的伤口"

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

descriptions.en:
"Please stay
Don't put out the flame and run away"

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
descriptions.zh:
"请留在我身边 
留下情热的火焰" 

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

descriptions.en:
"In this heart break
I'll be here fighting for you"

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
descriptions.zh:
"遍体鳞伤 
依然为你而战" 

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

descriptions.en:
"With a flicker of hope on the darkest of days
Now it feels like the end is near"

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
descriptions.zh:
"在最黑暗的日子里，仍怀揣着一丝希望 
现在感觉结局已经临近" 

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

descriptions.en:
"I thought I could take
More than I really can"

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
descriptions.zh:
"我以为我可以承受 
比实际的更多" 

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

descriptions.en:
"Baby 'til you come back with something
I know I'll never let it go"

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
descriptions.zh:
"宝贝，除非你带点什么回来 
我知道我永远不会放手" 

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

descriptions.en:
"I'm getting stronger but I still feel the pain"

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
descriptions.zh:
"纵然身强体壮，心痛却无处隐藏"

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

descriptions.en:
"I keep thinking I see you
And there's nobody there"

Earned by defeating a Technocyte Coda.
descriptions.zh:
"总幻想和你重逢 
到头来只是一场空" 

通过击败科技细胞终幕者获得。

descriptions.en: A fresh coating of ink marks the first step taken on the road to understanding the truth of the Shadowgrapher.
descriptions.zh: 新的墨水涂层标志着我们踏上了揭开绘影者真相的第一步。

descriptions.en: To see truth in the shapes created by this ephemera is a mark of increased understanding.
descriptions.zh: 能从幻纹所构成的形态中洞察真相，正是理解力日益深厚的标志。

descriptions.en: Celebrate the completion of Follie's Shadowgraph during Operation: Atramentum with a festive collection of balloons.
descriptions.zh: 通过这套节日气球的幻纹，在《行动代号：墨痕》中庆祝狂墨的绘影图的完成。

descriptions.en: Pay tribute to Jade and mark the battle of Operation Belly of the Beast with this transcendent Ephemera.
descriptions.zh: 用个超凡的幻纹来向圣天使致敬，并纪念《行动代号：兽之腹》的战斗。

descriptions.en: An even more radiant evolution of the Aspirus Ephemera, created with vestiges over Jade's volatile motes.
descriptions.zh: 由圣天使不稳定微粒留下的痕迹所形成，是追梦幻纹更加耀眼的进化版本。

descriptions.en: The pinnacle version of this ephemera, signifying victory over Parvos Granum’s forces in Operation Belly of the Beast.
descriptions.zh: 这是此幻纹的巅峰版本，象征着在《行动代号：兽之腹》中战胜帕尔沃斯·格拉努的军队。

descriptions.en: A fiery ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
descriptions.zh: 从一个感化或消灭的赤毒玄骸那里得到的炽烈幻纹。

descriptions.en: An icy ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
descriptions.zh: 从一个感化或消灭的赤毒玄骸那里得到的冰凉幻纹。

descriptions.en: An ephemera that echoes punishing impacts, seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
descriptions.zh: 从一个感化或消灭的赤毒玄骸那里得到的惩戒性冲击回声幻纹。

descriptions.en: A shocking ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
descriptions.zh: 从一个感化或消灭的赤毒玄骸那里得到的电击幻纹。

descriptions.en: A magnetic ephemera seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
descriptions.zh: 从一个感化或消灭的赤毒玄骸那里得到的磁力幻纹。

descriptions.en: An ephemera of toxic miasma seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
descriptions.zh: 从一个感化或消灭的赤毒玄骸那里得到的毒性瘴气幻纹。

descriptions.en: The energy of the trickster Warframes is embodied in this colorful ephemera, seized from a converted or vanquished Kuva Lich.
descriptions.zh: 战甲骗术的能量包含在这个多彩的幻纹里，从一个感化或消灭的赤毒玄骸那里得到。

descriptions.en: A dragon’s spirit graces your path.
descriptions.zh: 祥龙之气为你的道路增光添彩。

descriptions.en: Bring forth the fiery steeds of Dagath Yfari’s signature ephemera to follow in your footsteps.
descriptions.zh: 让无面骑影伊法里的标志性幻纹中那些炽热的骏马追随你的脚步。

descriptions.en: Step lightly with stones that could mend the very fabric of the heavens.
descriptions.zh: 随着轻盈的脚步踏出能够修补天空的五色石。

descriptions.en: Ethereal serpents slither in your caustic wake with Lavos Khymia’s signature Ephemera.
descriptions.zh: 通过无限术士点金标志性的幻纹，空灵的蛇影将在你留下的腐蚀性尾迹中蜿蜒爬行。

descriptions.en: Leave a trail of fragrant petals in your wake.
descriptions.zh: 在你身后留下一道芬芳花瓣的足迹。

descriptions.en: Flourish out of the muddiness of war.
descriptions.zh: 在战争的泥沼中繁茂生长。

descriptions.en: An evolving Ephemera that draws upon Sentient technology. Earn Focus with this Ephemera equipped to unlock two additional looks.
descriptions.zh: 一款利用灵煞技术发展出的可进化幻纹。装备这款幻纹获取专精点数时会额外解锁两个外观。

descriptions.en: An evolving Ephemera that draws upon Sentient technology. Earn Focus with this Ephemera equipped to unlock an additional look.
descriptions.zh: 一款利用灵煞技术发展出的可进化幻纹。装备这款幻纹获取专精点数时会额外解锁一个外观。

descriptions.en: An evolving Ephemera that draws upon Sentient technology.
descriptions.zh: 一款利用灵煞技术发展出的可进化幻纹。

descriptions.en: Embrace the look of 1999's most cutting-edge video game technology with this wireframe-themed Ephemera.
descriptions.zh: 通过这款以数字线战甲为主题的幻纹，你将领略到 1999 年最前沿电子游戏技术的风采。

descriptions.en: Sweet frequencies ripple through this Nightwave themed ephemera.
descriptions.zh: 甜蜜频率回荡于这个以午夜电波为主题的幻纹中。

descriptions.en: [PH] Description
descriptions.zh: 菌宝就是喜欢玩耍！蘑菇小子的标志性幻纹会在你脚边蹦蹦跳跳，调皮地提醒你深矿的未来。

descriptions.en: Everything is connected. Spores linger in your footsteps with this ephemera, evoking the underground web of life.
descriptions.zh: 万物皆有联系。孢子会随着这些幻纹萦绕在你的脚印，唤起地下的生命之网。

descriptions.en: The perfect flourish for a graceful Tenno.
descriptions.zh: 优雅天诺的完美修饰。

descriptions.en: A next-generation Ephemera.
descriptions.zh: 一个次世代的幻纹。

descriptions.en: Surround yourself with the dancing light of full spectrum flames.
descriptions.zh: 让自己沉浸在全光谱火焰的舞动光芒之中。

descriptions.en: Surround yourself with the growing dread of Oraxia's presence.
descriptions.zh: 让自己沉浸在因缚影蛛后的存在而产生的日益增长的恐惧之中。

descriptions.en: Surround yourself with a trio of orbiting energy -  earned on the Steel Path.
descriptions.zh: 三道绕轨能量在你身上环绕 — 在钢铁之路上获取。

descriptions.en: Become one with the overgrowth.
descriptions.zh: 与繁茂合而为一。

descriptions.en: Surround your Warframe with softly falling peach blossoms, to celebrate the Lunar Renewal.
descriptions.zh: 用轻柔的桃花包围你的战甲，用以庆贺新春佳节。

descriptions.en: The beast may be adorned, but never tamed. Voruna Prime's signature ephemera.
descriptions.zh: 野兽或许可以穿着华服，但永远不会被驯服。圣装赤影狼母的标志性幻纹。

descriptions.en: Distinguish yourself with the essence of nobility.
descriptions.zh: 以高贵风范彰显非凡。

descriptions.en: A temporal wave surrounds you.
descriptions.zh: 时泊波动环绕着你。
通过他的标志性幻纹，将辐能堡垒圣殿里那些翩翩起舞的伙伴们召唤到你身边。

descriptions.en: Let the familiar sands of Mars accompany you.
descriptions.zh: 让熟悉的火星之沙陪伴着你。

descriptions.en: Walk wreathed in Sentient unlight.
descriptions.zh: 行走在灵煞阴影的缭绕下。

descriptions.en: Emerge from the fog of war unscathed.
descriptions.zh: 毫发无伤地从战争迷雾中现身。

descriptions.en: Become the heart of the winter, beneath a cloud of falling snow.
descriptions.zh: 在一片雪花飘落的云朵下化作冬日之心。

descriptions.en: Surround yourself with the echoes of the fallen - earned on the Steel Path.
descriptions.zh: 亡者的余音在你身上环绕 — 在钢铁之路上获取。

descriptions.en: Bestowed upon those who joined together in celebration at TennoCon 2021.
descriptions.zh: 授予一同参与欢庆 TennoCon 2021 的玩家。

descriptions.en: Emulating the colossus of Hull, this ephemera is a reminder of the Tenno's past conflicts.
descriptions.zh: 效仿舰体的宏观之形，这个幻纹唤起了天诺对昔日冲突的追忆。

descriptions.en: Evoke the awe and beauty of solar winds with this delicate ephemera.
descriptions.zh: 通过这款精致的幻纹，唤起太阳风暴的浩瀚与美丽。

descriptions.en: Broadcast your presence with every move.
descriptions.zh: 通过一举一动来宣告你的存在。

descriptions.en: Take on the majesty of an angel’s wings.
descriptions.zh: 展现了天使之翼的威严。

descriptions.en: Walk in the echo of an ethereal song.
descriptions.zh: 走进空灵歌曲的回声中。

descriptions.en: Thunder erupts from within.
descriptions.zh: 雷电从内而发。

descriptions.en: The wolf-tail plume of Voruna Medeina’s signature ephemera displays the refined nature of an inner beast.
descriptions.zh: 赤影狼母梅迪娜的标志性幻纹中的狼尾羽展现了内在野兽的精致本性。

descriptions.en:
A rogue slinks, along a line
Deadly patience its tactic
In sparkling moonlight eyes shine
Ruthless, skulking arachnid
descriptions.zh:
离群恶棍线上渡
夺命只需耐心足
晶莹眼眸月光下
网上蛛影祟祟伏

descriptions.en: Share the path with your inner beast.
descriptions.zh: 带上你心中的野兽一起上路。

descriptions.en: Feel the whisper of the Void.
descriptions.zh: 感受虚空的低语。

descriptions.en: Creatures of the deep circle and play in your wake. Yareli Prime’s signature ephemera.
descriptions.zh: 深海生物在你身后盘旋嬉戏。圣装咏浪之灵的标志性幻纹。

descriptions.en: This unique skin was paid for with blood in the merciless crucible of Arbitration.
descriptions.zh: 这种独特的外观是在仲裁的无情试炼中，付以鲜血而得到的。

descriptions.en: This unique skin was paid for with blood in the merciless crucible of Arbitration.
descriptions.zh: 这种独特的外观是在仲裁的无情试炼中，付以鲜血而得到的。

descriptions.zh: 这种独特的外观是在仲裁的无情试炼中，付以鲜血而得到的。

descriptions.zh: 永恒烈焰战甲的迅捷站姿。

descriptions.en: The Immortal skin for the Ember Warframe.
descriptions.zh: 永恒烈焰战甲的不朽外观。

descriptions.en: The signature pistol skin of Ember Vermillion.
descriptions.zh: 永恒烈焰朱红的标志性手枪外观

descriptions.en: Ember Vermillion's signature helmet.
descriptions.zh: 永恒烈焰朱红的标志性头盔

descriptions.en: A flamethrower skin that's twice as hot as the carnage it contains.
descriptions.zh: 一件能发射其内在杀戮双倍热量的火焰喷射器外观。

descriptions.en: Ember Pyraxis's signature helmet.
descriptions.zh: 永恒烈焰燃烬的标志性头盔。

descriptions.en: Ember refined to her most searing elemental form, the primordial flame.
descriptions.zh: 永恒烈焰精炼成了她最灼热的元素形态，原初之火。

descriptions.en: The signature pistol skin of Ember Vermillion.
descriptions.zh: 永恒烈焰朱红的标志性手枪外观

descriptions.en: From the ashes of battle a flamboyant new Ember rises.
descriptions.zh: 在战斗的烟尘中冉冉升起的全新永恒烈焰。

descriptions.en: Ember Heirloom's signature helmet.
descriptions.zh: 永恒烈焰传家宝的标志性头盔。

descriptions.en: Heirloom skins signify the passage of time and the dedication of the Tenno. Ember's legacy is immortalized in the beauty of molten rock and volcanic fire.
descriptions.zh: 传家宝外观象征着时间的流逝和天诺战士的付出。永恒烈焰的传承在熔岩和火焰中永垂不朽。

descriptions.en: The standard issue helmet for the Ember Warframe.
descriptions.zh: 永恒烈焰的标准头盔。

descriptions.en: This helmet is worn by Ember, and reduces Shields in order to boost Energy Capacity.
descriptions.zh: 这顶头盔是由永恒烈焰所装备，可增加能量上限，但会减少护盾。

descriptions.en: This helmet is worn by Ember, and adds Health, with a reduction to Speed.
descriptions.zh: 这顶头盔是由永恒烈焰所装备，可增加生命值，但会减少移动速度。

descriptions.en: Backdraft Helmet for the Ember Warframe.
descriptions.zh: 永恒烈焰战甲的复燃头盔

descriptions.en: Phoenix Helmet for the Ember Warframe.
descriptions.zh: 永恒烈焰战甲的凤凰头盔

descriptions.en: The Noble Animation Set for Ember.
descriptions.zh: 永恒烈焰战甲的尊贵站姿。

descriptions.en: The standard issue helmet for the Ember Prime Warframe.
descriptions.zh: 圣装永恒烈焰标准头盔

descriptions.en: The standard issue skin for the Ember Prime Warframe.
descriptions.zh: 圣装永恒烈焰战甲的标准外观配置。

descriptions.zh: 永恒烈焰战甲的标准外观配置。

descriptions.zh: 穿戴上「扎里曼号」进行虚空跳跃期间产生的变形材料。该材料可表现出从液态到石质不等的化学结构。

descriptions.en: The Tales of Duviri tell of the Gynfas Kaithe visiting homes on a moonless night. To deny it entry is to invite dire misfortune. A fitting steed for Dagath Yfari.
descriptions.zh: 《双衍王境故事集》讲述了画布绝灵骥会在无月之夜造访各家各户。将它拒之门外会招致可怕的厄运。它是无面骑影炎灵的最佳坐骑。

descriptions.en: The macabre light of the Gynfas Kaithe’s tail has haunted many a moor and battlefield.
descriptions.zh: 画布绝灵骥尾巴上那阴森的光芒，曾萦绕许多荒野和战场。

descriptions.en: Forewarn that fury awaits anyone who challenges your Kaithe and its rider.
descriptions.zh: 事先警告，对于任何挑战你的绝灵骥和它的骑手的人，愤怒在等待着他们。

descriptions.en: A skilled rider repurposes the Void’s mark for their Kaithe.
descriptions.zh: 一位熟练的骑手将虚空的印记重新应用在他的绝灵骥上。

descriptions.en: Joy blossoms in the Myrthen Coronet.
descriptions.zh: 欢乐在欢馨马冠中开花。

descriptions.en: The Enverve Coronet elegantly expresses a bitter emotion.
descriptions.zh: 激妒马冠优雅地传达了一种苦涩的情感。

descriptions.en: The Wistfall Coronet depicts melancholy’s beauty.
descriptions.zh: 忧泣马冠展示了忧郁之美。

descriptions.en: Aetigo Kaithes are a native species of Duviri's southernmost island. Their emerald eyes once reflected the verdant plains they roamed, but when the island was reduced to ash, their eyes faded to nothing.
descriptions.zh: 因理绝灵骥是双衍王境最南端岛屿的本地物种。它们祖母绿色的眼眸曾经映照着它们踏过的青翠平原，但当岛屿化为灰烬之时，它们的眼睛也随之消逝。

descriptions.en: Psyacus Kaithes inspire fear in the faint of heart. Common wisdom among Duviri citizens holds that those who mount the Psyacus Kaithe must be either courageous or heartless.
descriptions.zh: 心道绝灵骥会在懦夫的心中唤起恐惧。双衍王境的民众普遍认为，那些骑上心道绝灵骥的人要么勇敢，要么无情。

descriptions.en: It is said that the great Dominus Thrax prefers Histornam Kaithes above all other breeds. It was on the back of a Histornam Kaithe that Thrax himself learned to ride.
descriptions.zh: 有言说伟大的士魂大帝最喜史源绝灵骥，胜于其他的所有品种。正是在一匹史源的背上，士魂大帝本人学会了骑乘。

descriptions.en: The might of the Kaithe rider is expressed through the Sviari Chamfron’s sharp horns.
descriptions.zh: 绝灵骥骑手的力量表现在瑞豚马盔的锋利之角上。

descriptions.en: The Dyrncaul Chamfron’s curved horns are reminiscent of the Tamm, a creature whose happiness is said to bring good fortune.
descriptions.zh: 勇角马盔的弯角让人想起塔牧羊，据说它的快乐会带来好运。

descriptions.en: The Irdeni Chamfron is reminiscent of the ever-changing hues in Duviri’s sky.
descriptions.zh: 复斓马盔让人想起双衍王境中千变万化的色调。

descriptions.en: The Kheyur Chamfron befits any formal occasion.
descriptions.zh: 华金马盔适合任何正式场合。

descriptions.en: The Dovin Saddle's deep curve and lightweight structure make for strong balance and gentle communication with the Kaithe.
descriptions.zh: 迹语石马鞍深沉的曲线和轻巧的结构使得绝灵骥兼具良好的平衡性和易于与骑手交流。

descriptions.en: The Vaidurian Saddle’s comfortable and sturdy design is ideal for those long hours riding Kaithes.
descriptions.zh: 猫睛石马鞍舒适坚固的设计非常适合长时间骑乘绝灵骥。

descriptions.en: Style and comfort meet in the Sohseki Saddle. Its padding provides stability and protection during jumps.
descriptions.zh: 杀生石马鞍兼具酷炫与舒适的特性。它的填充物在跳跃过程中具备很好的稳定性和保护性。

descriptions.en: The Caersid Tail bespeaks the spirit of the vengeful warrior.
descriptions.zh: 战坞马尾彰显着复仇战士的精神。

descriptions.en: A Kaithe with the Heoro Tail evokes glory.
descriptions.zh: 拥有荣英马尾的绝灵骥召唤出荣耀。

descriptions.en: Adorn the movements of an elegant Kaithe with the Velific Tail.
descriptions.zh: 用灵现马尾装饰优雅的绝灵骥的动作。

descriptions.en: Bones laid bare in the Aebolg Tail are a reminder to appreciate the gift of life.
descriptions.zh: 骨棘马尾上裸露的骨头提醒着人们珍惜生命的馈赠。

descriptions.en: The Histornam Kaithe came into being with this regal tail.
descriptions.zh: 史源绝灵骥诞生之时就有着这条华丽的尾巴。

descriptions.en: The Aetigo Kaithe came into being with this dignified tail.
descriptions.zh: 因理绝灵骥诞生之时就有着这条气派的尾巴。

descriptions.en: The Psyacus Kaithe came into being with this tapered tail.
descriptions.zh: 心道绝灵骥诞生之时就有着这条锥形尾巴。

descriptions.en: Outstretched wings reveal the path to celestial planes.
descriptions.zh: 展开的双翼揭示了通往天外位面之径。

descriptions.en: Fan the flames of fortitude with the Aethon Chamfron.
descriptions.zh: 用神驱马盔扇起坚韧的火焰。

descriptions.en: The Aethon Saddle's flames don't burn the skilled rider.
descriptions.zh: 神驱马鞍上的火焰并不会灼伤熟练的骑手。

descriptions.en: The Aethon Tail is a good companion piece to the rider of fleet-footed fire.
descriptions.zh: 神驱马尾是迅猛骑手的好搭档配件。

descriptions.en: Beware the fearsome yet elegant curves of the Aumen Chamfron's horns.
descriptions.zh: 当心金兆马鞍锐利的角及其可怖而优雅的弧度。

descriptions.en: Stylish spikes bely the true comfort of the Aumen Saddle.
descriptions.zh: 金兆马鞍虽有时髦尖刺，实则舒适无比。

descriptions.en: A grand tail for a magnificent beast.
descriptions.zh: 雄伟野兽的大尾巴。

descriptions.zh: 莲在古老的死亡与恶作剧节日中的吸血鬼风格打扮。

descriptions.en: A friend to all Tenno, basing her face and voice upon their beloved Archimedean Margulis.
descriptions.zh: 所有天诺战士的挚友，她的面容和声音都基于他们最爱的哲士玛古丽斯。

descriptions.en: The form Lotus took at the moment of her victory over Ballas.
descriptions.zh: 莲战胜拜勒斯之刻的形态。

descriptions.en: After being blinded in a tragic accident with one of her charges, Margulis wore the scars as a badge of pride, never turning her back on her beloved children.
descriptions.zh: 在一次与她照顾的孩子发生的悲惨事故中失明后，玛古丽斯将疤痕视为骄傲的勋章，因为她从未背弃过她心爱的孩子们。

descriptions.en: The form Natah took when she reverted to her Sentient nature.
descriptions.zh: 当娜塔恢复了她的灵煞本性时所选择的形态。

descriptions.en: Modeled on the Tenno's beloved Archimedean Margulis to honor her memory and give them comfort.
descriptions.zh: 以天诺最爱的哲士——玛古丽斯为原型，谨此纪念她并为天诺带来慰藉。

descriptions.en: Remember wisdom through renewal.
descriptions.zh: 通过更新铭记其中的智慧。

descriptions.en: Strike with precision and prosperity on your side when you equip this Hespar skin.
descriptions.zh: 用这款暮斩的外观使出精准的斩击，繁荣昌盛将随之而来。

descriptions.en: Soar into the coming year with the power of the honorable dragon.
descriptions.zh: 带着尊贵之龙的力量，翱翔天际进入新的一年。

descriptions.zh: 使用这款努寇微波枪外观来辟邪迎祥。

descriptions.zh: 使用这款食人魔外观，为战场带来繁荣。

descriptions.zh: 使用这款螺钉步枪外观在严峻的战斗考验中完成蜕变。

descriptions.en: Carve your own destiny with this Dual Swords skin.
descriptions.zh: 用这款双剑外观开创你自己的命运。

descriptions.zh: 通过这款精巧的金玉迅发电浆炮外观来集新年的好运于一身。

Switch between Mag and Aoi's fully voiced, customizable Gemini Skin with the included Aoi Gemini Emote, even during missions.

诸星碧是六人组的保卫者副官，她为磁力战甲带来了人性化的一面。
